teaser: You pour two drinks on a rooftop at dusk, lights just starting to string themselves across the city, and you are halfway back toward the door before anyone notices you left the group by the railing. That is the shape of a 7 moving through an ENFP: a pull toward people so strong it looks involuntary, and a pull away from them just as strong, both true in the same ten minutes. Life path 7 asks for solitude, long study, a private argument with the unknown. ENFP asks for company, motion, a room that talks back. In you, the two don't cancel. They trade shifts.
